scope: Close the complete Java OnSkillGranted callback frontier so Publish 14.1 skill-box awards cannot wake inherited NGE progression, reward, profession, Beast Master, or level authority while retained Force Rank, Creature Handler/familiar cosmetics, Tansarii guidance, badges, JTL, and command synchronization continue to work.

findings: Publish 14.1 skill awards may legitimately update commands, badges, Jedi Force Rank titles, Creature Handler state, JTL pilot setup, and tutorial presentation.
NGE skill families, passive class runtimes, Spy runtime, and Beast Master player state must be rejected or cleaned before any normal skill-grant effect executes.
A complete callback inventory is required because a new listener can bypass otherwise-correct centralized skill admission through post-grant side effects.
